decisions.reason: Although no later website evidence is visible, this printer is very close to the firm’s core coding and inkjet knowledge, so a large R&D-active supplier would more likely refine or reposition it than abandon it quickly.
The numbering software module directly extends the installed printing base and supports digitalization and traceability, so the firm can readily absorb user feedback and keep developing it.
This coder builds on the firm’s existing ink, substrate and inkjet capabilities for a clear industrial use case, which makes continued commercialization more likely than withdrawal.

The decoding app is somewhat more peripheral than the hardware lines but still leverages the firm’s code-reading and compliance know-how, so management would usually keep it as a complementary offering.
Inline code verification fits especially well with the firm’s strategic move toward end-to-end traceability and with its technical base in marking systems, making retention highly likely.
Print layout design software complements the firm’s marking systems and can be improved through its existing software and customer application knowledge, so it is likely to be kept.
